test: open the workflows hub after a /sync bounce, and take the onboarding user through the first-run wizard

Fixes the remaining failures of the [2026-10-30 production run](https://openbraininstitute.github.io/obi-e2e/runs/2026-10-30-11h50-production/report/index.html). The four listing-memory failures are already fixed on `main` by #55; production runs `release`, which did not have it yet.

**Small microcircuit, "The form will not launch" (1 test).** A project route whose server-side `getProject` fails redirects to `/app/virtual-lab/sync`, which lands on the project home after the document already sat at `/workflows`. `openWorkflowsHub` checked the URL and then waited 30 s for a hub that never came. It now retries the nav until the category menu itself is visible. Transient; seen once.

**Onboarding (1 test, and the five after it).** On production the onboarding user owned no virtual lab, so `/sync` showed the first-run wizard instead of a workspace. It failed on every production run so far. The first test now goes through the wizard when it shows (country, affiliation, Create virtual lab, Go to project) and records the lab and its first project, so the existing onboarding teardown deletes both. `scenario.md` gains that step first.

On staging the onboarding user still has a lab made by hand on 2026-09-09, so the wizard is skipped there. Deleting that lab once would make staging test the wizard too.

Side effects on production, per run: creating a lab provisions Keycloak groups, an accounting account with 100 welcome credits, a Stripe customer and a welcome email to the placeholder address. Lab deletion is soft.

### Verified

| Run | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Staging, hub spec | passed, three runs |
| Production, onboarding scenario | 10 of 10 passed twice; teardown removed the lab both times |
| Staging, onboarding scenario | 10 of 10 passed |
| format, lint, typecheck, site check, casebook, unit tests | pass on this branch |

The end-to-end runs were made from another branch with the same four files. Between that base and `main`, only `fixtures/checks/filter.ts` differs, by an export these specs do not use.

Reaches staging and production with the next `main` → `release` PR.

Follow-up for core-web-app: the first-run wizard has no test ids. The spec uses role and title locators until it does.

ci: retry GitHub release downloads in the Bun build and the gitleaks install

## What

Fixes woojubb/robota#3865 (closes it on merge). Three steps of the pull-request gates download GitHub release assets, and all three now survive a transient failure.

- **`Release — Bun binaries`, step `Build workspace`:** retries `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` up to four times, pausing 20, 40 and 60 seconds between attempts, and still fails when the fourth attempt fails. Its timeout rises from 10 to 15 minutes to cover the retries, and it runs under `bash` on every runner like the neighbouring steps.
- **`secret-scan`, step `Install gitleaks`:** the download is `curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors`. The checksum check after it still verifies the file, and a download that keeps failing still fails the step.
- **`Release — Bun binaries`, step `Package and exercise the unsigned desktop product`:** only the `electron-builder --dir` command is retried (four attempts, 20, 40 and 60 second pauses; the step timeout rises from 10 to 15 minutes). The build, bundle and end-to-end commands around it still run once.

## Why

Since the afternoon of 2026-11-08 GitHub release downloads intermittently answer HTTP 504 or time out on the runners:

- The install scripts of `better-sqlite3` and `node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch` cannot fetch their prebuilt binaries, fall back to `node-gyp` source builds that fail on the runners, and turn `native-validation` red (woojubb/robota#3854 failed five attempts, woojubb/robota#3856 two).
- `Install gitleaks` fails on one 504, which fails `secret-scan` and the required `security` check. This pull request's own first run hit it.

- On woojubb/robota#3856 the `electron-builder` download of the desktop packaging step died with `socket hang up` after the install itself had passed.

All three are required checks (through `native-validation` and `security`), so every pull request that gets the full plan is blocked by an outage that has nothing to do with it.

A retry of the pnpm install is safe because of how pnpm behaves, which was reproduced with the pinned pnpm 8.15.4: when an install script fails, the next `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` runs that script again and the build completes if the download works. The retry repeats the native build that failed; it cannot skip it for the modules in question (an optional dependency's failed script is non-fatal in pnpm and is not covered; neither module in woojubb/robota#3865 is optional).

## Evidence

- The `pnpm` loop under `bash -eo pipefail` with a stand-in `pnpm`: fails twice then succeeds (build runs, exit 0); fails four times (exit 1, build does not run); succeeds first time (one install, exit 0).
- `curl` against a local server that answers 504 twice and then 200: without the flags it exits 22; with `--retry 5 --retry-delay 1 --retry-all-errors` it exits 0 and writes the body. Against a server that answers 504 nine times it still exits 22 after the retries.
- Both workflow files parse as YAML; the two Bun steps are `shell: bash`, `timeout-minutes: 15`.
- The reviewer approved the first two commits with no findings and reproduced the pnpm mechanism independently; the electron-builder commit is reviewed as its own delta.
- The real test is this pull request's own run: a pull request runs the workflow files from its own merge ref.

## Harness note

`AGENTS.md` asks that a harness change reduce total lines unless a reproduced failure and the owner's decision justify an exception. This adds 21 lines and removes 5. The failures are reproduced above and the owner told the session on 2026-11-08 to fix the cause instead of waiting for the downloads to recover.

## Not changed

`release-desktop-app.yml`, `publish.yml` and the other workflows run the same install command but are not pull-request gates. The `windows-sdk-check` action has its own retry in woojubb/robota#3857's work. They change only if they fail the same way.

Enhance EditSchedulerFormModal with 12-hour format and options

This pull request refactors the scheduler form to support both 12-hour and 24-hour time formats and improves the user interface by replacing free-text numeric inputs with dropdown selects for hours, minutes, and intervals. It also introduces better validation and handling of time values, and adds new styling for the updated form layout.

**Time Format Support and Logic Improvements:**

* The scheduler form now detects and adapts to the user's preferred time format (12-hour or 24-hour), updating the hour selection and AM/PM handling accordingly. (`index.tsx` [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-aff84b41bc856fd615d0dba845102ff7077b4ede6c0d8ba8b8e4d6bf20b0c726L5-R45) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-aff84b41bc856fd615d0dba845102ff7077b4ede6c0d8ba8b8e4d6bf20b0c726R54-R91)
* Time value handling and validation have been improved, including correct conversion between 12-hour and 24-hour formats and clamping of interval values. (`index.tsx` [src/renderer/src/pages/Home/components/EditSchedulerFormModal/index.tsxR54-R91](diffhunk://#diff-aff84b41bc856fd615d0dba845102ff7077b4ede6c0d8ba8b8e4d6bf20b0c726R54-R91))

**UI/UX Enhancements:**

* Numeric `Input` fields for hours, minutes, and intervals have been replaced with `Select` dropdowns, reducing user error and improving consistency. AM/PM selection is shown when in 12-hour mode. (`index.tsx` [src/renderer/src/pages/Home/components/EditSchedulerFormModal/index.tsxL102-R146](diffhunk://#diff-aff84b41bc856fd615d0dba845102ff7077b4ede6c0d8ba8b8e4d6bf20b0c726L102-R146))
* New CSS classes and layout adjustments have been added to accommodate the new input structure and improve form appearance. (`EditSchedulerFormModal.module.css` [src/renderer/src/pages/Home/components/EditSchedulerFormModal/EditSchedulerFormModal.module.cssR1-R13](diffhunk://#diff-b363446a8beee9cbd08b718c77a7c8584ffdb60c5071b4b9065188e9e872c14cR1-R13))

**New Utility and Options Definitions:**

* A new utility file, `scheduleTimeOptions.ts`, provides shared option lists for hours, minutes, and meridiem, supporting both 12-hour and 24-hour formats. (`scheduleTimeOptions.ts` [src/renderer/src/utils/scheduleTimeOptions.tsR1-R31](diffhunk://#diff-4bf01b380f4ec7bb1b4d5f5bba89484665808ded5443cad0ae22e86282ca6b6cR1-R31))

fix(lsp): kotlin leaves no gradle daemon behind, and stops offering convert java to kotlin

## Decision taken on Matthew's behalf

**The Kotlin server's Gradle runs without a daemon.** kotlin-language-server resolves a Gradle project's classpath by running Gradle, which by default leaves a daemon running for hours after the server has gone.

| Option | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| **No daemon (chosen)**: `GRADLE_OPTS=-Dorg.gradle.daemon=false` for the server | Nothing outlives the session. A classpath resolution pays a cold Gradle start (on the fixture, warm caches: 36 s to settle, against 51 s for the first, cold-cache run with a daemon). |
| Short idle timeout | The daemon stays for a re-resolve after a build-file edit, then exits. `org.gradle.daemon.idletimeout` is a Gradle property, and I could not confirm `GRADLE_OPTS` reaches it. |
| `gradlew --stop` when the session ends | Stops **every** daemon of that Gradle version for the user, including their own terminal builds'. Ruled out. |

Why: correctness over speed. Resolution runs at start and when a build file changes, not on each keystroke. The user's own `GRADLE_OPTS` are kept, placed first. To reverse it, drop the `GRADLE_OPTS` line in `kotlinServerEnv` (`language-server-catalogue.ts`).

---

Part of #1209, probe bugs 1 and 3 (gap items 3 and 4).

## What changes

1. **No Gradle daemon left behind.** `kotlinServerEnv()` builds the server's environment: `JAVA_HOME` as before, plus `GRADLE_OPTS`. `scripts/probe-lsp.mjs` mirrors it.
2. **Convert Java to Kotlin is not offered in a Kotlin file.** The server offers its one code action, `convertJavaToKotlin`, on every span of every `.kt` file, the probe's error included. Nothing there is Java, so it sat in the lightbulb on every problem. A code action whose command converts **from** another language is now offered only in a document of that language. In Studio that means never, as `.java` files go to jdtls, but the rule is stated, not hard-coded to "drop".

## Verified

The real kotlin-language-server 1.3.13, Studio's real capabilities, on a Gradle 8.9 / Kotlin 2.1.0 fixture:

| Run | Classpath | Gradle daemons after the server exits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| As today | resolved, 0 diagnostics | **1** (PPID 1, still running; stopped by hand) |
| With this change | resolved, 0 diagnostics | **0** |

Both runs log `Successfully resolved dependencies … using Gradle` for the project and the build script.

Code action on a `.kt` span, real server: `[{ title: "Convert Java to Kotlin", command: "convertJavaToKotlin" }]` and nothing else. With this change the menu is empty there.

Unit: `language-server-catalogue` (three new cases) and `lsp-features` (two new cases). `build:electron` passes.

**Not run in the real app.** Gradle had to run outside the agent sandbox, because it writes `~/.gradle`. It ran against the fixture only.

## Not changed

- **`-32603` for an unadvertised method** (gap item 5). Studio only asks what a server advertises, so it does not get these from Kotlin. The probe saw them because it asks everything. The stack traces the server logs land in its log channel, which is where they belong.

fix(web): 入金待ちの領収書は入金日を初期値なしにし、入力するまでダウンロードできなくする

Closes #159

> **このPRは #191（#160）の上に積んでいます。** マージ先は `fix/160-business-date-jst` です。#191 のマージ後に `main` へ向け直します。差分には #159 の変更だけが出ます。

## 背景

Issue #159 の当初の要件（「領収書は確認済みの Payment からだけ」）は、#185 で更新された spec によって撤回されている。今の spec（`spec/requirements.md` FR-015 → Receipt Timing、`spec/frontend.md#Invoice and Receipt Documents`）では、対面契約に備えて**入金待ち（WAITING）の Payment でも領収書を生成できる**。

今の spec とコードを比べ、食い違っている部分だけを直した。

| Payment の状態 | 金額の初期値 | 入金日の初期値 |
|---|---|---|
| WAITING | 請求額（変更なし・spec どおり） | spec：初期値なし・手入力。**今日の日付が入っていた → 修正** |
| CONFIRMED | spec：実入金額（`receivedAmount`）。**未実装のため対象外** | 確認日（変更なし・spec どおり） |

## 変更内容

- `lib/payment-labels.ts` に `receiptPaymentDate` を追加：確認済みなら確認日、入金待ちなら空。年度別企業詳細と財務画面の両方で使う
- 領収書モーダル：入金日が空のあいだはダウンロードできず、「入金を受け取った日を入力してください」と表示する
- `spec/development.md` の E2E「Covered flows」にこのテストを追記

## 対象外

確認済みのときの金額の初期値を実入金額（`receivedAmount`）にする部分。`receivedAmount` は DB・API にまだなく、実装には DB の変更と `models.go` の変更が要るため、別の Issue で扱う。

## 確認

- [x] E2E を追加：入金待ちでは金額 80,000円・入金日が空で、ダウンロードできない。入金日を入れると押せる。財務画面で確認した後は、入金日の初期値が確認日になる
- [x] #158（PR #190）と組み合わせた確認：#190 を取り込んだ一時ブランチで、入金確認の直後に再読込せずに開いても確認日が入る。このブランチ単体では、モーダルが古い値を使い続ける #158 の不具合が残っているため、テストは再読込してから確かめている
- [x] #190 とは競合なくマージできる
- [x] E2E 16件、Web の単体テスト 25件が通る
- [x] `tsc --noEmit` / ESLint でエラーなし

benchmarks.task_description:
Measure a lazy hold from the paragraph, not its container

Closes #4692
Refs markup-carve/carve#5471 (carve-js)

This is a follow-up to #4691, and the sweep for that PR found the loss. Lists carry no position on the PART 12 wire. A comment after a quoted list therefore counted as held lazily by the list's last paragraph, whatever line the comment was on. The hydrated source then left out the quote marker. The hold is now read from that paragraph's own end line.

Input:

```
> - [^a]: x
+
%% c
- b
```

Before, direct fmt:

```
> - {empty}
> %% c
>
> - b

[^a]: x
```

Before, through the AST (reads back with the comment outside the quote):

```
> - {empty}
%% c
>
> - b

[^a]: x
```

After, both paths: the same as the direct output above, which is the Expected section of #4692.

Variants: the same 6480-variant sweep as #4691. Direct and AST fmt now differ on 177 variants (187 after #4691, 2868 on the base before it). No variant got worse on any check against the pre-#4691 base. The new case is added to `test/ast-round-trip-erased-line-spelling.test.ts`.
